# mlorente.dev

> Manu Lorente's personal site and engineering platform. Systems & Platform Engineer — infrastructure under autonomous AI agents, Kubernetes bare-metal, local inference, and GitOps.

## About

Manu Lorente is a Systems & Platform Engineer with 10+ years of engineering experience across Spain, France, China, and the US. Background spanning CMOS image sensor testing, cleanroom hardware, low-latency firmware, Linux kernel systems, Go concurrency, and production Kubernetes platforms. Currently focused on building sovereign AI infrastructure, autonomous agent execution harnesses, and reproducible cloud-native systems.

## Site Structure

- / — Homepage: engineering thesis, featured open-source systems, latest technical notes, and verified GitHub commit activity.
- /lab/ — The KubeLab Platform: hybrid cloud (Hetzner, GCP) and bare-metal homelab topology, interactive architectural flows, service catalog, real-time SLOs, and client-side reachability probe.
- /ai/ — Autonomous AI Harness: deterministic execution harnesses for stochastic AI models (OS concurrency, worktree sandboxing, in-stream secret redaction, and multi-model adversarial review gates).
- /notes/ — Technical notes and deep dives covering systems engineering, Kubernetes internals, networking (Split DNS, WireGuard), and GitOps failure modes.
- /contact/ — How to work with Manu: Systems & Platform Implementation (Service-as-a-Software) and Strategic Systems Engineering (Staff / Technical Advisory).
- /es/ — Complete Spanish localization of all platform pages and technical notes.

## Core Engineering Domains

Systems Engineering, Platform Engineering, Kubernetes (K3s), Infrastructure as Code (Ansible, Terraform), Docker, GitOps (Argo CD), Autonomous Agent Harnesses, Local LLM Inference (vLLM, Ollama), Networking (WireGuard, Headscale/Tailscale, Split DNS, CoreDNS), Linux POSIX Primitives, Go, Python, Zero-Trust Security (Authelia, CrowdSec).

## Flagship Systems & Proof of Work

- KubeLab: 24/7 hybrid cloud and bare-metal platform IDP (K3s, VPN mesh, SSO, full Prometheus/Grafana observability, automated GitOps delivery).
- Deterministic AI Harness: OS-level agent execution framework featuring AST loop circuit breakers, zero-copy worktree sandboxing, in-stream secret scrubbing, and cross-model adversarial audit gates.
- Pollex: Local LLM inference engine operating on edge hardware (Jetson Nano).
